info.title: PDK.CLI
info.description: Pipeline Development Kit - Run CI/CD pipelines locally

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the pipeline file (auto-detects .github/workflows/*.yml or azure-pipelines.yml if not specified)

options.name: --job
options.description: Specific job to run (runs all if not specified)

options.name: --step
options.description: Specific step to run within a job

options.name: --host
options.description: Run directly on host machine instead of Docker

options.name: --docker
options.description: Force Docker execution mode (fail if Docker unavailable)

options.name: --runner
options.description: Runner type: 'docker', 'host', or 'auto' (default)

options.name: --validate
options.description: Validate pipeline without executing

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress step output (show only job/step status)

options.name: --trace
options.description: Enable trace-level logging (most verbose)

options.name: --silent
options.description: Show only errors (suppress all other output)

options.name: --log-file
options.description: Path to write text log file

options.name: --log-json
options.description: Path to write JSON-formatted log file

options.name: --no-redact
options.description: Disable secret redaction in logs (WARNING: may expose secrets)

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Run in interactive mode for guided pipeline exploration

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to configuration file (auto-discovers if not specified)

options.name: --var
options.description: Set variable (NAME=VALUE, can be repeated)

options.name: --var-file
options.description: Load variables from JSON file

options.name: --secret
options.description: Set secret (NAME=VALUE, WARNING: visible in process list)

options.name: --no-reuse
options.description: No effect: every job runs in a fresh container

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable Docker image caching (always pull images)

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Run independent jobs concurrently (dependencies still run first); output lines are prefixed with the job name

options.name: --max-parallel
options.description: Maximum number of jobs to run at the same time with --parallel (default: 4)

options.name: --metrics
options.description: Show performance metrics after execution

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch for file changes and re-execute pipeline automatically

options.name: --watch-debounce
options.description: Debounce period in milliseconds (default: 500)

options.name: --watch-clear
options.description: Clear terminal between watch mode runs

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate pipeline and show execution plan without executing

options.name: --dry-run-json
options.description: Output dry-run results to JSON file (implies --dry-run)

options.name: --step-filter
options.description: Run specific step(s) by name (can be repeated, case-insensitive)

options.name: --step-index
options.description: Run specific step(s) by index (e.g., '3', '1,3,5', '2-5', '1,3-5,7')

options.name: --step-range
options.description: Run range of steps (e.g., '1-5' or 'Build-Test')

options.name: --skip-step
options.description: Skip specific step(s) by name (takes precedence over include filters)

options.name: --include-dependencies
options.description: Automatically include dependencies of selected steps

options.name: --preview-filter
options.description: Preview which steps will run and exit without execution

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Show filter preview and confirm before execution

options.name: --preset
options.description: Load filter preset from configuration file

options.name: --no-deps
options.description: With --job: run only the selected job, not the jobs it depends on

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail the job when it contains an action or task PDK cannot run (default: skip with a warning)

options.name: --event
options.description: Event name presented to the pipeline (github.event_name / Build.Reason), e.g. push, pull_request

options.name: --keep-containers
options.description: Keep job containers after the run for inspection (Docker mode)

options.name: --param
options.description: Parameter or input value as NAME=VALUE (Azure 'parameters', GitHub 'inputs'); repeatable

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the pipeline file (auto-detects if not specified)

options.name: --details
options.description: Show detailed step information

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format (table, json, minimal)

options.name: --param
options.description: Parameter or input value as NAME=VALUE (Azure 'parameters', GitHub 'inputs'); repeatable

options.name: --full
options.description: Show full system information including Docker status, providers, and executors

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format (human, json)

options.name: --no-update-check
options.description: Skip checking for updates

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check system requirements and Docker availability
